Kinetic-Tracker · Experimental refinement

Kinetic-Tracker
Motion & Compute Study

A native C++ tracking study with validation-based selection, frozen comparison inputs, and additional confirmation clips. Every score below is derived from saved artifacts.

FROZEN CONFIRMATION
Quality association · every frameTwo-stage controlBalanced validation HOTA 51.88
Budget association · validated separatelyHybrid motion + recoverySchedule: Adaptive · legacy cue / all risk
Additional confirmation9 clips · 1781 framesNine additional non-insect categories
Exact-count schedule pairs96Inputs and association/output knobs checked

The recorded outcome

At every-second-frame detection, hybrid motion changed mean HOTA from 35.82 to 36.55 (+0.74 points) across 9 additional clips with identical 893 detector calls. 6 clips improved and 3 regressed. Every-frame quality retained Two-stage control.

New executable backward-compatible two-stage control.

There was no new detector training. Quality experiments replay fixed author-provided detections, simulated detections, or explicitly labelled oracle boxes. Detector-call reduction does not itself establish a live speedup.

The current two-stage control produced byte-identical MOT outputs to the frozen v2 executable on 7/7 recorded validation cases.

Read the evidence by scope

Validation / selectionSix synthetic scenarios and a natural insect validation clip. Source weights and the raw-insect guard are declared in the protocol. Every failed candidate remains visible.
Reused exploratory evidenceEarlier insect and synthetic test clips were already inspected. Their refinement results are exploratory and are not relabelled as untouched test evidence.
Additional confirmationNine additional non-insect category clips were declared before scoring and evaluated after validation selection was frozen. One clip per category cannot establish recording-independent generalisation or full-benchmark performance.

Primary tables use output_policy=active: confirmed, non-lost estimates within the output horizon, including deliberate detector skips. Lost-output diagnostics remain separate.
